summary.en-US: The 2015–2025 cash-to-revenue median rises in all-company, dated-industry and fixed-company comparisons. A retrospective screen classifies 43,589 of 59,167 candidates as listed and non-ST on reconstructed signal dates; 43,055 also have dated industry matches. None has an observed mapped PIT vintage at its signal date. These are descriptive accounting ratios, not wage or return conclusions. No returns were read.
summary.zh-CN: 2015—2025 年现金支出/营收中位数在全样本、带时点行业样本和固定公司队列中均上升。回溯筛查中，59,167 条候选记录有 43,589 条在重建信号日处于上市且非 ST 状态，其中 43,055 条另有带日期的行业匹配；没有记录在其历史信号日拥有已观测的映射 PIT 版本。这些是描述性会计比率，不代表工资或收益结论。本次没有读取收益。

label.zh-CN: 员工现金支出输入审计，2026-10-14

label.en-US: Industry, cohort, accounting and PIT follow-up, 2026-10-14
label.zh-CN: 行业、队列、会计口径与 PIT 补充审计，2026-10-14

title.en-US: Separate payable balances from expense flows
title.zh-CN: 区分应付款余额与费用流量

question.en-US: Is employee compensation payable a wage measure?
question.zh-CN: 应付职工薪酬是否代表工资？

finding.en-US: It is a period-end liability; it is not current-period wages or R&D staff investment.
finding.zh-CN: 它是期末负债，不代表当期工资或研发人员投入。

decision.en-US: Do not treat a balance change as a verified labor-cost factor.
decision.zh-CN: 不能将余额变化视为已验证劳动成本因子。

title.en-US: Stored cash and payable disclosures are widely populated
title.zh-CN: 已存现金支出与应付余额的字段覆盖较高

question.en-US: Are labor flows and workforce counts comparable?
question.zh-CN: 劳动成本流量与人数是否可比？

finding.en-US: Employee cash expenditure is finite in 222,125 of 222,529 stored statements (99.82%); payables in 218,429 of 220,208 (99.19%). Current employee counts are populated in 6,291 of 6,294 company records, but are not a historical workforce series.
finding.zh-CN: 222,529 条已存现金流量表中，222,125 条有有限的员工现金支出值（99.82%）；220,208 条资产负债表中，218,429 条有应付余额值（99.19%）。6,294 条当前公司资料中有 6,291 条员工人数，但这不是历史人数序列。

decision.en-US: Use cash expenditure as a defined flow proxy. Do not label it accrued wages or backfill current headcount. Population among stored rows does not establish historical universe completeness.
decision.zh-CN: 以现金支出作为定义明确的流量代理，不将其称为应计工资，也不回填当前人数。已存记录的字段覆盖不能证明历史股票池完整。

title.zh-CN: 构建同年度可比的现金支出指标

question.en-US: Can annual cash, revenue and assets form comparable candidate records?
question.zh-CN: 年度现金支出、营收和资产能否形成可比候选记录？

finding.en-US: The matched nonfinancial annual panel contains 59,167 positive finite records. Conflicting cash, revenue and asset values exclude 57, 453 and 796 source keys, respectively; the exclusions overlap. A further 119 common rows fail positive finite inputs.
finding.zh-CN: 非金融企业同年度匹配后得到 59,167 条输入为正且有限的记录。现金、营收和资产分别有 57、453、796 个来源键存在金额冲突，已排除；这些排除范围存在重叠。另有 119 条共同样本因输入非正或非有限而排除。

decision.en-US: Use annual cash/revenue, cash/assets, cash growth and the revenue-minus-cash growth spread. Growth needs adjacent calendar years; do not turn year-to-date quarters into standalone-quarter values.
decision.zh-CN: 先使用年度现金支出占营收、占资产、支出增长及营收与支出增长差。增长要求连续年度，不把季度累计数当作单季度值。

title.en-US: Qualify original versions and historical eligibility
title.zh-CN: 核验原始财报版本与历史资格

question.en-US: Does populated data establish what was known at the formation date?
question.zh-CN: 字段覆盖高是否证明形成时点已经知道这些信息？

finding.en-US: None of the 128 current PIT data partitions exposes compensation fields. The separate statement-observation ledger is completed but explicitly lacks complete historical revisions; availability follows actual retrieval as well as disclosure.
finding.zh-CN: 128 个当前 PIT 数据分区均未暴露薪酬字段。独立财报观测账本虽已完成，但明确不具备完整历史修订记录；可见时间同时受真实获取日和披露日约束。

decision.en-US: Keep the return hypothesis untested until original vintages, dated universe and matched controls are qualified. A recent retrieval must not be assigned an old announcement date as its original availability.
decision.zh-CN: 原始版本、历史股票池和共同控制变量核验通过前，收益假设保持未检验。不能将近期获取的财报倒填为早年公告时点已知。

question.en-US: Does labor information add to industry and size?
question.zh-CN: 劳动信息是否在行业与规模之外有增量？

finding.en-US: No candidate-level predictive results have been published for this family.
finding.zh-CN: 该家族尚无已发布逐因子预测结果。

decision.en-US: The next test is registered, but no performance chart is released. Input coverage and distribution charts do not measure investment performance.
decision.zh-CN: 后续检验已登记，尚不发布绩效图。输入覆盖和分布图不衡量投资表现。

question.en-US: Did the overview update add predictive evidence?
question.zh-CN: 总览更新是否带来新的预测证据？

finding.en-US: The changes add navigation and R&D follow-up links. Human-capital definitions and evidence status are unchanged; no predictive backtest was added.
finding.zh-CN: 变化是新增导航和研发后续入口。人力资本定义与证据状态一致，没有新增预测回测。

decision.en-US: Retain hypothesis status and qualify expense flows and headcount before testing.
decision.zh-CN: 保留研究假设状态，预测前核验费用流量与员工人数。

title.en-US: Compare changing coverage with a fixed company cohort
title.zh-CN: 对照变化中的覆盖范围与固定公司队列

question.en-US: Does the ratio trend persist across industry and fixed-company comparisons?
question.zh-CN: 现金支出占营收的趋势在行业对照和固定公司队列中是否仍存在？

finding.en-US: The all-company median rose from 12.41% to 15.95%; the dated-industry sample from 11.88% to 16.05%; equal-weight L3 industry median from 12.26% to 14.68%; and the 3,749-company fixed cohort from 12.54% to 15.33%. Industry match coverage increased from 62.4% to 90.0%. Six annual keys exceed the operating cash outflow subtotal; compensation fields are absent in all 21 retained PIT snapshots.
finding.zh-CN: 全样本中位数从 12.41% 升至 15.95%；带时点行业样本从 11.88% 升至 16.05%；L3 行业等权中位数从 12.26% 升至 14.68%；3,749 家固定公司队列从 12.54% 升至 15.33%。行业匹配覆盖率由 62.4% 升至 90.0%。6 个年度键超过经营现金流出小计；21 期已留存 PIT 快照都没有薪酬字段。

decision.en-US: Treat this as descriptive accounting evidence only. Reconcile the six keys and qualify original availability before opening the registered return test.
decision.zh-CN: 仅将其视为描述性会计证据。先核对这 6 个异常键并确认原始可得时间，再考虑开放已登记的收益检验。

title.en-US: Reconstruct eligibility without claiming historical PIT availability
title.zh-CN: 重建历史资格，但不视为历史 PIT 可得

question.en-US: How many annual candidates were listed, non-ST and industry-classified on a reconstructed signal date?
question.zh-CN: 在重建信号日，有多少年度候选仍在上市、非 ST 且有行业分类？

finding.en-US: Of 59,167 candidates, 43,589 were listed and non-ST on reconstructed signal dates; 43,055 also had dated industry matches. None had an observed mapped PIT vintage at the signal date.
finding.zh-CN: 59,167 条候选中，43,589 条在重建信号日处于上市且非 ST 状态；其中 43,055 条另有带日期的行业匹配。没有记录在该信号日拥有已观测的映射 PIT 版本。

decision.en-US: This qualifies retrospective sample construction only. It does not establish point-in-time factor availability and does not open the return test.
decision.zh-CN: 这只核验了回溯样本构建，不证明因子在当时真实可得，也不开放收益检验。

title.en-US: Stored disclosure population by report year
title.zh-CN: 按报告年份查看已存字段覆盖

metric.en-US: Finite-value share among stored statement rows
metric.zh-CN: 已存报表记录中有限值的占比

context.en-US: All stored report periods, including duplicate versions. This is not historical universe completeness or return performance. 2026 contains only reports through the second quarter.
context.zh-CN: 包含各报告期及重复版本；这不是历史股票池完整率或收益绩效。2026 年仅含截至第二季度的报表。

interpretation.en-US: Cash coverage stays high; payables are less complete in early years. High population does not certify original availability.
interpretation.zh-CN: 现金支出字段覆盖一直较高，应付余额早期缺失较多。高覆盖不能证明原始时点可得性。

title.en-US: Annual candidate sample and growth availability
title.zh-CN: 年度候选样本及增长指标覆盖

metric.zh-CN: 同证券、同年度的匹配记录数

context.en-US: Annual nonfinancial statements, 2015–2025; positive finite cash, revenue and assets; conflicting source keys excluded. This is not historical universe completeness or a historically tradable stock list.
context.zh-CN: 2015—2025 年非金融企业年报，现金、营收和资产均为正且有限，已排除来源金额冲突。这不是历史股票池完整率，也不是历史可交易股票池。

interpretation.en-US: 59,167 annual records and 52,203 adjacent-year growth records. The first year has zero growth records because 2014 is outside this input snapshot.
interpretation.zh-CN: 共 59,167 条年度记录及 52,203 条连续年度增长记录。首年增长记录为零，因为输入快照不含 2014 年。

title.en-US: Employee cash expenditure relative to annual revenue
title.zh-CN: 年度员工现金支出占营收的分布

metric.en-US: Cross-sectional percentiles of annual cash expenditure / annual revenue
metric.zh-CN: 年度员工现金支出占年度营收的截面分位数

context.en-US: The same annual candidate panel, with changing company composition. These are raw descriptive ratios, not wages, an industry-adjusted trend or a return signal.
context.zh-CN: 使用上述年度候选样本，公司构成随年份变化。这是原始比率的描述性分布，不是工资、行业调整后的趋势或收益信号。

interpretation.en-US: The median moves from 12.41% to 15.95%. Changing coverage and industry mix prevent attributing this to within-firm wage growth. No predictive direction was selected.
interpretation.zh-CN: 中位数从 12.41% 变为 15.95%。覆盖与行业构成变化使其不能归因于同一批企业的工资增长，尚未选择预测方向。

title.zh-CN: 不同年度样本的现金支出占营收中位数

metric.zh-CN: 员工现金支出 ÷ 营收 · 中位数

context.en-US: 2015–2025. Dated industry match coverage rises from 62.4% to 90.0%, so the matched sample changes. Fixed cohort: 3,749 companies observed in every year. This is not a wage or return conclusion.
context.zh-CN: 2015—2025 年。带时点行业匹配覆盖率从 62.4% 升至 90.0%，匹配样本构成会变化。固定公司队列为每年均有记录的 3,749 家公司。这不是工资结论或收益结论。

interpretation.en-US: All four descriptive medians rise, including the fixed cohort. Differences can reflect accounting classification and company composition; this does not establish higher wages, labor productivity or predictive value.
interpretation.zh-CN: 四条描述性中位数均上升，包括固定公司队列。差异仍可能受会计分类和公司构成影响，不能据此认定工资或劳动生产率上升，也不能证明具有预测价值。

next_question.en-US: After original-version and historical-universe qualification, do cash-expenditure candidates add predictive information beyond industry, size, valuation and profitability on a common sample?
next_question.zh-CN: 原始版本与历史股票池通过核验后，现金支出指标能否在共同样本上提供超出行业、规模、估值和盈利能力的预测信息？

before.en-US: Employee compensation payable might proxy current wages.
before.zh-CN: 应付职工薪酬可能被当作当期工资代理。

trigger.en-US: The field is a period-end liability balance.
trigger.zh-CN: 该字段为期末负债余额。

after.en-US: Require expense flows and workforce coverage before a predictive test.
after.zh-CN: 预测检验前须取得费用流量与员工人数覆盖。

before.en-US: Input coverage and a usable labor-flow proxy had not been audited.
before.zh-CN: 输入覆盖和可用劳动流量代理尚未审计。

trigger.en-US: The stored-disclosure audit and matched annual construction completed with immutable input hashes.
trigger.zh-CN: 已完成存储披露审计与同年度指标构建，并保留输入哈希。

after.en-US: Employee cash expenditure supports annual candidate construction. Historical revisions, workforce series and predictive evidence remain unresolved.
after.zh-CN: 员工现金支出支持年度候选指标构建；历史财报版本、人数序列和预测证据仍待解决。
